s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly growing, variegated skin lesion with recent color change
salient_findings: Enlarged and variegated plaque on the left axilla
Lesion color changed to dark brown
key_facts: Female patient in her 70s
Lesion present for 4 years
Lesion started as a small eczematous, pink-to-brown plaque
Lesion is asymptomatic
Lesion has well-demarcated margins
No breast mass or lymphadenopathy detected
Incisional biopsy revealed an intraepidermal neoplasm
Pagetoid cells have round, pale vacuolated cytoplasm and large pleomorphic nuclei
Immunohistochemical staining positive for CK7 and EMA
Numerous reactive dendritic HMB-45–positive melanocytes scattered among tumor cells

shortlist.label: Extramammary Paget's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Intraepidermal neoplasm with pagetoid cells and positive staining for CK7 and EMA

shortlist.label: Mammary Paget's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Similar histopathological features, but less likely due to absence of breast mass or lymphadenopathy

shortlist.label: Melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of numerous reactive dendritic HMB-45–positive melanocytes scattered among tumor cells

shortlist.label: Pagetoid dyskeratosis
shortlist.why_kept: Pagetoid cells with round, pale vacuolated cytoplasm and large pleomorphic nuclei

shortlist.label: Bowen's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Intraepidermal neoplasm with similar histopathological features

raw.rationale: The presence of an intraepidermal neoplasm with pagetoid cells, positive staining for CK7 and EMA, and the location of the lesion in the axilla are consistent with Extramammary Paget's disease.

rejected.label: Mammary Paget's disease
rejected.why: No breast mass was detected, making this diagnosis less likely

rejected.label: Melanoma
rejected.why: The immunohistochemical staining profile and the presence of pagetoid cells are not typical for melanoma

rejected.label: Pagetoid dyskeratosis
rejected.why: This condition typically presents with a different histological appearance and is not as well-defined as the presented case

rejected.label: Bowen's disease
rejected.why: The clinical and histological features, including the presence of pagetoid cells and specific immunohistochemical staining, do not align with Bowen's disease
